ns2:section.sectionText: This is an overflow section for MATH 473. Students in this section will complete this course completely online except for the following which must be completed on-campus: Exams (will be completed in the classroom with the instructor/TA) in the same manner as for students registered for in-classroom delivery. Instructions on submission of homeworks will be provided in class materials.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Mathematics major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
